claim_limits: No claim predicts the sign of the initiating spot move.
No gross-open-interest construction is accepted as dealer inventory.
No gamma wall is a guaranteed support, resistance, magnet, or target.
Historical support cannot authorize capital until the separate prospective protocol matures.
Trade-level GRK observations alone cannot represent aggregate minute-level dealer gamma; a complete one-minute option surface is mandatory.

claims.estimand: incremental post-shock realized-variance and continuation response associated with lagged verified OMM gamma and gamma-by-spot-shock interaction
incremental calibrated probability of pin versus break after a preregistered standardized approach event

baselines: always buy ATM straddle and delta hedge
simple trailing realized-volatility minus implied-volatility rule
Cboe GAMMA Index directionally aligned benchmark where licensed/available
claims.estimand: net executable PnL of delta-hedged long-gamma episodes selected only by an ex-ante realized-variance forecast versus implied variance
claims.primary_loss: net PnL and proper-score improvement after option spread, hedge spread, slippage, latency, fees, and financing

frozen_expected_calendar.calendar_basis: XNYS regular trading sessions used as frozen SPX/C1 RTH common-session calendar; any vendor exception must be documented before lockbox opening and cannot silently change the list.

quote_surface.position_join: exact formatted_symbol, latest position state at or before quote minute
quote_surface.stale_position_rows: permitted only for still-active unexpired series because position is a state

data_integrity.series_inception_rule: Only series whose complete trade history is present from first observed trade are admissible; series already active at acquisition start are quarantined through expiry.

decision_purpose: test whether verified aggregate options-market-maker gamma changes post-shock volatility response
test whether verified signed gamma concentration adds incremental pin/break information
test whether an ex-ante volatility forecast can identify net profitable delta-hedged long-gamma episodes

inference.multiple_testing_family: all V72 claims, horizons, candidate specifications, and all earlier related trials

changes: Option Quotes 1-minute Include Calcs made mandatory for full surface marks
Frozen RTH calendar added for independent daily completeness verification
GRK retained only as optional trade-time QA
Option Quotes Include Open Interest made mandatory for the preregistered gross-OI topology baseline and pseudo-sign placebo
pre_outcome_amendment.reason: Trade-level Greeks cannot mark inactive series; manifest-supplied calendars cannot detect synchronized missing days; and the frozen gross-OI baseline/placebo cannot be computed without explicit open interest.

minute_option_surface.purpose: mark every active SPX/SPXW series each minute, including non-traded series; provide unsigned OI topology baseline without inferring dealer sign
minute_option_surface.selection: ^SPX, 1-minute interval, Include Calcs + Include Open Interest, per-day files

trade_greeks_optional_crosscheck.role: trade-time join QA and executable-trade analytics; never a substitute for full one-minute surface marks

trade_records.product: Cboe Enhanced US Options Trade-by-Trade Execution Detail

required: active_underlying_price from licensed ^SPX Option Quotes/CGIF or separately licensed one-minute SPX
one-minute executable ES spread or depth proxy

required_all: validation improvement over every preregistered baseline is positive
untouched-lockbox improvement over every preregistered baseline is positive
family-wise adjusted 95% lower confidence bound is above zero
effect sign agrees with the causal mechanism
verified dealer sign materially outperforms unsigned gamma and gross-OI pseudo sign
all preregistered placebo controls fail to create the claimed edge
result remains positive with one-bar latency and double estimated transaction costs
no single month contributes more than 30% of aggregate improvement
minimum independent-date and event counts are met
full trial ledger and failed specifications are retained

prospective_requirement.protocol: V71 signed append-only ledger or later compatible successor

temporal_design.lockbox_open_rule: one time after code, hashes, trial ledger, and promotion thresholds are frozen
